sources.snippet: Model Information The Meta Llama 3.1 collection of multilingual large language models (LLMs) is a collection of pretrained and instruction tuned generative models in 8B, 70B and 405B sizes (text in/text out). sources.title: Llama 3.1 | meta-llama/llama-models | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 represents a significant advancement in the Llama model series with extended context length (128K tokens), multilingual capabilities, and improved performance across various tasks. For information about other Llama model versions, see Llama 3.2, Llama 3.3, and Llama 4. For general model architecture details, see Model Architecture.

sources.snippet: Llama[a] (" Large Language Model Meta AI " serving as a backronym) was a family of large language models (LLMs) released by Meta AI starting in February 2023.
